title: Comments on rock and roll bands
summary: A brief fragment about rock and roll bands and a band heard on television.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Some of these, especially these knock and roll bands and things like that.
Yes, yes. Is one band you heard over television, you say, at about the same time?
Yes, the same tempo, same downbeat. I don't know, I think it's just a makeup band, because I never see them anywhere, never hear them. But they were at the University of the Funchestore.
